name: Universal Humanoid Robot
summary: A full-size biped from a home-appliance maker better known for robot vacuums, and an example of how far into humanoids the Chinese consumer-robotics industry has moved. Six degrees of freedom per leg let it balance on one foot; its best-known demonstration is pouring latte art. Dreame also shows wheeled ECHO research platforms for laundry and tidying.
notable: Humanoid program from a robot-vacuum manufacturer

sources.title: Dreame expands beyond robot vacuums at IFA 2026 with physical-AI concepts — GSMDome
